title: National Carillon (Canberra)

place.label: Aspen Island, Lake Burley Griffin, Canberra

mass_note: about 32,000 kg in all; bells from 7 kg to 6,000 kg (NCA)

timeline.event: Opened; a gift of the British Government
Upgrade adds two bells, including the 5 t Ngunnawal bell

tiers.everyday: Canberra's National Carillon stands on an island in Lake Burley Griffin. Britain gave it to Australia in 1970.
tiers.student: The National Capital Authority gives an opening on 26 April 1970, 57 bells totalling about 32,000 kg (7 kg to 6,000 kg) by John Taylor & Co, a 50 m tower, and a 2020 upgrade that added two bells including a 5 t Ngunnawal bell. Whether 57 includes the 2020 bells is [UNKNOWN].

model.label: Not modelled: a ring, carillon or set has no single bell profile in the cited sources.
